name: Réka Kovács
bio:
Réka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aircraft design, which naturally led her to the advanced materials used in racing cars. After completing her degree in composite engineering at Budapest University of Technology and Economics, she sought out opportunities to apply her skills in a fast-paced environment. She landed an internship with a small racing team where she quickly proved her aptitude for problem-solving and hands-on work.

Réka approaches her work with a blend of meticulous attention to detail and a willingness to experiment with new techniques. She thrives on the challenge of optimizing composite structures for weight reduction and improved performance. Her colleagues value her ability to think outside the box and her unwavering commitment to achieving the highest standards.

What sets Réka apart is her innovative spirit combined with a deep understanding of material science. She is always eager to learn and adapt to the latest advancements in composite technology, making her a valuable asset to any racing team looking for an edge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Réka has a focused gaze and a slender build, often seen with streaks of resin on her overalls.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces while deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while working on intricate composite layups.
